title: User | thepilotnews.com - Top 30 Finalists Revealed in the Song Academy Young Songwriter 2026 Competition: "CRUNCHING YUMMY VEGGIE LOVE" by Shouvik Ramgir Earns National Recognition
text:
Chosen from a large number of entries, the song impressed judges with its originality, memorable concept, and youthful creativity. The selection highlights the growing talent of young songwriters who are using music to tell stories, express ideas, and connect with audiences in unique ways. A Young Songwriter's Creative Voice Shines Through MRF Films is delighted to announce that "CRUNCHING YUMMY VEGGIE LOVE" by Shouvik Ramgir has been selected among the Top 30 Finalists in this year's youth songwriting showcase. Celebrating Original Songwriting
Songwriting is one of the most personal forms of creative expression. Every lyric, melody, and idea reflects a different perspective, and this year's finalists demonstrated an impressive range of imagination and musical ability.
" CRUNCHING YUMMY VEGGIE LOVE " stood out for its playful approach and engaging theme. The song captures a sense of fun while showcasing strong creative thinking, proving that great songwriting can come from the most unexpected inspirations.
For Shouvik Ramgir , being named among the Top 30 Finalists marks an important milestone and reflects the dedication invested in developing original music.
Encouraging the Next Generation of Creators
Opportunities that recognise young songwriters play an important role in helping emerging artists gain confidence and visibility. For many participants, the experience is about more than competition; it is a chance to share their work, receive recognition, and continue developing their creative skills.
The success of young creators like Shouvik demonstrates the value of encouraging artistic exploration from an early age. When young people are given a platform to showcase their ideas, they often surprise audiences with their originality and fresh perspective.
A Song That Leaves a Lasting Impression
What makes a song memorable is not always technical complexity. Sometimes it is a unique idea, a distinctive voice, or an ability to make listeners smile.
" CRUNCHING YUMMY VEGGIE LOVE " achieved exactly that. Its creative concept and energetic spirit helped it resonate during the judging process and secure a place among this year's finalists.
The recognition celebrates not only the song itself but also the imagination and enthusiasm behind it.
Looking Ahead
As the journey continues for this year's finalists, MRF Films is proud to celebrate the achievements of talented young creators who are contributing fresh ideas to the world of music and songwriting.
We congratulate Shouvik Ramgir on this well-deserved recognition and look forward to seeing where his creative journey leads next.
About MRF Films
MRF Films is dedicated to supporting emerging talent across music, film, and the creative arts. Through initiatives that recognise and encourage young creators, MRF Films continues to provide opportunities for aspiring artists to share their work, develop their skills, and reach wider audiences.
Reference and Acknowledgement
The announcement of the Top 30 Finalists has been inspired by the format and recognition approach used by Song Academy's Young Songwriter Competition, which continues to celebrate and support emerging songwriting talent.
For further information about the Top 30 Finalists announcement and the Young Songwriter 2026 Competition, please visit:
https://www.songacademy.co.uk/top-30-finalists-of-the-young-songwriter-2026-competition-are-revealed/
MRF Films appreciates initiatives that encourage young creators to develop their artistic abilities and showcase their original work to wider audiences.
